verdict.rationale: The evidence describes skills functionally: they can bundle executable scripts, and on the API they run in the code execution environment. Nothing in the pack documents a security posture. There is no statement on what skills are allowed to execute, no trust model or vetting for third-party or marketplace skills, and no disclosure of telemetry or data collection. Related controls such as disabling bundled skills, SDK skill-invocation controls, hooks and OpenTelemetry export are different features and do not deliver this story.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, the project documents its security posture — what skills can execute, the trust model for third-party skills, and any telemetry or data collection
